title: When the Orchard Wakes
author: Bram Vasquez
blurb: Ada Eriksen, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
